title: The Bonding
tagline: to bond is to stop being alone.
style_block: 2D animated fantasy illustration, flat cel colour, bold flowing linework with Art Nouveau influence in the natural forms only, anime-influenced expressive faces with large eyes, heavy dark ink outlines, painterly comic key-art lighting, cinematic composition, warm ember palette of burnt orange, gold, deep blood-red and pale cream, with pale silver reserved for the broken sky-ring, organic curves in every natural form, no decorative border, no filigree frame, no text, no lettering, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no logo, no signature
audio_clause: Ambient sound only. No speech, no voices, no singing, no narration.

character_blocks.ROOK: a young man in his early twenties with wind-blown loose dark hair, sharp quiet eyes, normal human skin, fully clothed in a layered tunic and trousers of tanned leather and woven bark-cloth in burnt orange and pale cream, barefoot, a curved pale knife at his belt, simple tribal tattoo bands on his arms
character_blocks.CINDER: a horned wildcat the size of a big hound, not lion-sized, orange and cream fur, a scarred muzzle and one torn ear, curved ridged horns sweeping back, an ordinary furry animal, fur not fire, no flames on the animal

character_blocks.MOTH: a small horned lynx kitten with soft silver and orange tabby fur, oversized paws, two tiny budding horns, an ordinary furry animal, fur not fire, no flames, no glowing, no antennae, no flowers
character_blocks.BRAM: a proud headstrong seventeen-year-old with tied-back dark hair, heavier build, normal human skin, fully clothed in a layered tunic and trousers of tanned leather in burnt orange and pale cream, tribal tattoo bands
character_blocks.THORNCLAW: a large black-furred cat, unmistakably feline with a broad flat cat face, whiskers, tufted ears, soft paws and a long cat tail, with two short curved horns on its brow, about the size of a big hound, not a goat and not a ram, no hooves, an ordinary furry animal, fur not fire
character_blocks.YARROW: a very old Vael elder woman, one eye milk-white and blind, deeply lined face, long grey hair, fully clothed in draped robes of woven cloth in pale cream and burnt orange hung with feathers and small carved bone charms, holding a gnarled wooden staff
character_blocks.SEDGE: a wary lean man fully clothed in a tunic of woven cloth in reed-teal and pale cream, wet dark hair, marsh-dry expression, a long green water-serpent coiled about his shoulders

shots.shot: a vast night forest seen from high above, an endless canopy of curving treetops silvered by moonlight, an enormous shattered ring of pale silver light arcing across the entire sky above, broken into separate segments with clear gaps, tiny orange campfires glowing far below like embers dropped into black moss
shots.motion: slow aerial drift forward over the canopy
shots.caption: They say the sky was whole, once.

shots.shot: a vast shattered ring of pale silver light filling the night sky above a curving forest canopy, the broken segments drifting with faint shimmer, stars between them
shots.motion: very slow tilt up along the broken ring
shots.caption: No one now living remembers it unbroken - and no one remembers what broke it.

shots.shot: a Vael forest camp at night in a hollow ringed by enormous ancient curving trees, hide tents, drying racks and woven lanterns glowing warm, a low cooking fire, lived-in and peaceful
shots.motion: slow drift through the camp, lantern light swaying
shots.caption: The Vael move when the land tells them to. Tonight, the land said: stay.

shots.shot: a wiry thirteen-year-old girl crouched alone at the edge of a firelit camp, knees drawn to her chest, staring out into the dark forest, wide frightened eyes
shots.motion: slow push in on her face

shots.shot: a young man crouching down to the level of a seated thirteen-year-old girl at the edge of a night camp, offering her a strip of dried meat, both half-lit by firelight
shots.motion: hold, firelight flicker, slight push in

shots.shot: a large horned wildcat padding quietly into frame behind a seated young man at a night campfire, its scarred muzzle and torn ear catching the firelight
shots.motion: slow lateral drift as the animal enters frame
shots.caption: Everyone's stomach is full of moths, their first bonding. Mine was.

shots.shot: a large horned wildcat lowering its great head to sniff a young girl's hair as she sits very still, delighted and frightened, warm firelight
shots.motion: slow push in on the two heads

shots.shot: a young man scratching the torn ear of a large horned wildcat, the animal's eyes half closing in contentment, firelight
shots.motion: hold, small movements only
shots.caption: The bond cares whether you are honest. Lynxes cannot stand a liar.

shots.shot: a proud headstrong seventeen-year-old walking past a campfire with a lean dark-furred horned wildcat at his heel, younger children trailing behind him, firelight catching the animal's eyes
shots.motion: slow lateral tracking as he passes
shots.caption: Or whether you are worthy. Some people the fire just says no to.

shots.shot: a young man rising slowly to stand between a swaggering older boy and a small seated girl at a night camp, calm and unhurried, not raising his voice
shots.motion: slow push in from behind Rook
shots.caption: The fire has not refused a Vael child in my lifetime.

shots.shot: a young man watching someone walk away, a flicker of tiredness crossing his face, one hand resting on the curved pale knife at his belt, firelight
shots.motion: very slow push in on his face
shots.caption: He did not yet feel like a chief. He felt like a boy wearing his mother's knife.

shots.shot: a young man crouched level with a thirteen-year-old girl by firelight, speaking to her honestly and directly, both faces lit warm
shots.motion: hold, slow push in
shots.caption: Because you are scared of it. Only the honest ones are scared.

shots.shot: an elder striking a great hide drum at night, concentric rings of light rippling outward through the air from the drumskin, the camp turning toward the sound
shots.motion: hold, the rings ripple outward

shots.shot: a very old blind-eyed elder woman raising a gnarled staff at the mouth of a stone-ringed fire pit, feathers and bone charms hanging from her robes, tall firelight on her face
shots.motion: slow push in
shots.caption: The land said stay. The fire says now.

shots.shot: a whole tribe gathered in a wide ring around a stone-ringed fire pit at night, faces lit gold, a small girl being walked toward the centre
shots.motion: slow drift around the outside of the ring
shots.caption: Every Vael is born half a soul. The other half waits in the fire.

shots.shot: a stone-ringed ceremonial fire burning strangely, flames too tall and too orange, faint shapes seeming to move within the fire, beautiful and unnerving
shots.motion: slow push in toward the flames
shots.caption: Look into it, child. Not with your eyes.

shots.shot: a thirteen-year-old girl standing alone at the edge of a tall ceremonial fire, firelight painting her face, the silent watching tribe dark behind her
shots.motion: slow push in on her face

shots.shot: a very old blind-eyed elder woman standing behind a young girl at a fire, her staff planted in the ground, speaking low and certain
shots.motion: hold, firelight flicker
shots.caption: You are looking. Stop looking. Ask.

shots.shot: extreme close up on a girl's eye with a tall fire reflected in it, and within the reflection two smaller lights appearing like a pair of eyes opening in the flame
shots.motion: very slow push in on the eye
shots.caption: ...is someone there?

shots.shot: a lynx kitten formed of ember-light stepping out from within a tall fire and coalescing into fur and flesh as it walks forward, curling flame-tendrils around it, low angle
shots.motion: slow push in, flames and embers moving
shots.caption: They do not come from the fire. They come through it -

shots.shot: a small horned lynx kitten walking out of firelight toward the viewer, its fur resolving from ember-glow into ordinary silver and orange tabby fur
shots.motion: slow push in on the kitten
shots.caption: - from wherever the other half of a Vael soul has been waiting.

shots.shot: a thirteen-year-old girl slowly kneeling and holding out one trembling hand to a small horned lynx kitten, tears standing in her wide eyes, firelight
shots.motion: hold, slow push in
shots.caption: Hello.

shots.shot: a small horned lynx kitten pressing its forehead into a girl's open palm, a soft pulse of warm light radiating outward from the touch in concentric rings
shots.motion: hold, the light pulses outward

shots.shot: close on a thirteen-year-old girl's face as she gasps in recognition, eyes wide and wet, firelight, a small lynx kitten's head under her hand
shots.motion: very slow push in on her face
shots.caption: To bond is to stop being alone in a way you never knew you were.

shots.shot: a whole tribe around a great night fire throwing their arms up in celebration, horned wildcats yowling, a girl spinning with a lynx kitten held in her arms, sparks flying up
shots.motion: hold, wide, everything moving

shots.shot: a thirteen-year-old girl holding a small horned lynx kitten up above her head, fierce and certain, all fear burned off, firelit tribe behind her
shots.motion: slow push in on the girl and kitten
shots.caption: Moth. Her name is Moth.

shots.shot: a night celebration around a high fire, food passed hand to hand, a reed pipe playing, children chasing lynx cubs between the tents, warm and full and alive
shots.motion: slow drift through the celebration
shots.caption: The Vael have few certain things. So they hold hard to the ones they have.

shots.shot: a young man and a thirteen-year-old girl sitting together at the quiet edge of a fire, a lynx kitten asleep in her lap, a large horned wildcat sprawled at his feet
shots.motion: hold, firelight flicker, slow push in
shots.caption: Where do they wait? Before?

shots.shot: a young man looking up past dark treetops at an enormous shattered ring of pale silver light in the night sky, wondering, firelight below on his face
shots.motion: slow tilt up from his face to the broken ring
shots.caption: No one does. Same place the sky went, maybe.

shots.shot: two young men sitting near a low fire late at night, a large horned wildcat and a lean dark-furred horned wildcat touching noses between them, tired and companionable
shots.motion: hold, firelight flicker
shots.caption: You are allowed to let people in.

shots.shot: a sleeping Vael camp deep at night, lanterns guttering low, the enormous broken silver ring bright overhead, wide and quiet and beautiful
shots.motion: very slow drift across the sleeping camp
shots.caption: It was, everyone agreed later, one of the good nights.

shots.shot: close on a large horned wildcat's scarred face in darkness, lit only by pale ring-light, its eyes snapping open and ears going up, a low growl building
shots.motion: hold, only the eyes and ears move

shots.shot: a young man crouched barefoot at the edge of a dark camp beside a large horned wildcat, both staring east, his hand already on the knife at his belt
shots.motion: slow push in from behind them

shots.shot: a dull orange glow staining the night sky far off above a black treeline, seen across a dark forest, the wrong direction and the wrong colour for dawn
shots.motion: very slow push in toward the glow
shots.caption: ...that's not the dawn.

shots.shot: a very old blind-eyed elder woman leaning on a gnarled staff at the edge of a dark camp, her blind white eye turned toward a distant orange glow as if she can feel it
shots.motion: slow push in on her face
shots.caption: The old word is Ironfolk.

shots.shot: a Vael camp being struck at first grey light, tents coming down, packs loaded, elders steadied, cubs carried, hurried but controlled
shots.motion: slow drift through the breaking camp
shots.caption: This time the land did not ask.

shots.shot: a black scar of felled and burned trees cut dead straight through a vast curving forest canopy, seen from a high ridge, straight as no natural thing is straight
shots.motion: slow drift along the straight scar
shots.caption: Only one thing draws a straight line. Something that wants to.

shots.shot: a young man walking at the rear of a long column of tribespeople on a forest trail, turning to walk backward a few steps to watch the way they came, a horned wildcat beside him
shots.motion: slow tracking behind him
shots.caption: A chief walks last, so he is the final thing between his people and the dark.

shots.shot: a wide unfamiliar valley opening below a ridge at golden hour, a silver river snaking through it, strange rock formations, a tribe cresting the rise above
shots.motion: slow tilt down to reveal the valley
shots.caption: By dusk they had gone farther west than any of them had ever walked.

shots.shot: a lone figure crouched half-hidden among tall reeds across a wide river at last light, with no wildcat beside them but a long water-serpent coiled around their shoulders, head raised
shots.motion: slow push in across the water toward the figure
shots.caption: The Vael believed themselves the last of their kind.

shots.shot: close on a wary figure among river reeds turning their head sharply toward the viewer, caught and alarmed, a long water-serpent rearing at their shoulder with its hood flaring
shots.motion: hold, the head turns and the serpent rears
shots.caption: They were wrong.

prompt_traps: NEVER write 'flame-lynx' in a generation prompt. The models literalise it into a fire elemental with flames, chrome fur and antennae. Say 'horned lynx' and let the palette carry the ember association. The species name is for the script, not the prompt.

ALWAYS state clothing coverage explicitly for Sorrel. Left unspecified, the models produced a bare-midriff outfit on a thirteen-year-old. Say 'modest practical full-length tunic covering shoulders chest and legs'.
'Art Nouveau linework' alone tips into decorative gold filigree borders framing the image. Say 'Art Nouveau influence in the natural forms only' and add 'no decorative border, no filigree frame'.

Character plates drift further from house style than environment plates. Environment plates came back consistent; the character plate did not. Re-check every character plate against an approved one before accepting it.

NEVER leave 'hide' and 'bone' as bare colour/material adjectives. A figure described as 'in ember-orange and bone hide' rendered as a creature covered in fire-coloured fur with a skeleton showing through. Always attach a garment noun - 'a layered tunic of tanned leather and woven cloth' - and use 'pale cream' rather than 'bone' as a colour. Add 'no skeleton, no exposed bones, no fur' to any prompt describing a clothed Vael.

A 'horned wildcat' with 'curved ridged horns sweeping back' renders as a GOAT or antelope - goat face, hooves, long spiral horns. Cinder survives because his description is dense with cat cues (scarred muzzle, torn ear, orange tabby fur). For any other bonded cat, anchor felinity explicitly: 'unmistakably feline, broad flat cat face, whiskers, tufted ears, paws, long cat tail' plus 'two SHORT curved horns' and an explicit negative - 'not a goat, not a ram, not an antelope, no hooves, no beard, no long spiral horns'.
